svg.title: Idea to prototype
svg.desc: Animated workflow from idea to prototype. Paddington supplies an evidence package, Shuri a research brief and Angela an intelligence package. Eminem writes the PRD and Mary files it to Slite. I trigger Eminem manually to create the Jira tickets. Tony takes the PRD as his brief, challenges the scope and builds a Figma prototype with design system, copy, accessibility and design critique checks. Mary files the prototype to Tony Artifacts only after I approve it.
svg.text: Paddington, Shuri and Angela supply the evidence.
Eminem writes the PRD from that evidence.
Mary files the PRD to Slite.
Aadeel triggers Eminem to create Jira tickets.
The PRD is Tony's brief. He challenges the scope.
Tony builds the prototype and runs quality checks.
Mary files it only once Aadeel approves.
Evidence feeds the PRD. Tony builds the prototype. Nothing is filed until Aadeel approves.
